subject: Oven #2 thermostat repair
body: Hi Ken, the thermostat on oven #2 is dead and the part arrives tomorrow morning. Sato Kitchen Service will replace it then. Let me know if you need anything adjusted in the meantime.

subject: Flour quote request - 25kg bags, October delivery
body:
Hello,

I'm writing from Komorebi Bakery to request a quote for 25 kg bags of bread flour, approximately 28 bags per month, with deliveries starting from October.

Could you please provide your current pricing and delivery schedule?

Best regards,
Komorebi Bakery

subject: Loyalty discount request - Mill Co flour
body:
Dear Mill Co,

We've been loyal customers for nine years and value our partnership. With your 8% price increase effective October 1st (25kg bag from ¥6,300 to ¥6,800), we wanted to ask if you could offer a loyalty discount to maintain our current rate.

We typically order about 28 bags per month starting in October. Any consideration would be greatly appreciated.

Best regards,
Komorebi Bakery

subject: Re: Flour price and loyalty discount
body: Thank you for the 2% loyalty discount — ¥6,664 per 25kg bag from October 1. We'll stay with Mill Co and keep our croissant price at ¥380. Best regards, Komorebi Bakery
